label: The owner's storage settings before anything is saved
description_nl: What Settings holds on a fresh portal. help_video_url: the walkthrough shown on the Gemini key guide (blank = none). max_upload_mb: the largest single upload. quota_gb: what one account may hold (0 = no quota). keep_source_days: days a raw recording is kept after its narrated copy exists (0 = for ever). A portal on your own laptop wants these; a hosted portal sets all three, because storage is its only bill.
weight_basis: Portal operating limits, no scoring. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python. Owner-only (audience admin): a looser value here would open a security hole or spend the owner's disk, so editors see and test it but cannot change it.
